title: KKE Audio Demo
description: Every case the audio engine handles, one station each: open field, small stone room, great hall, padded room, sounds through wood/glass/stone walls, a sound coming round through a door, falling crates of six materials, footsteps on six grounds, a tick circling your head (binaural) and navigation pings. Turning the camera turns your ears.

requirements.notes: Best-effort, developer-declared estimates -- see docs/HISTORY.md 'Estimated hardware requirements'. Headphones recommended for the binaural station.
